resources.string: Lets Delphis work Dolphin\'s own menu for you: it presses \"Exit Emulation\" when you leave or restart a game, and Quick Save / Quick Load for autosaves and the Saves list. While a game runs it also watches for the quick save buttons (Select + L1 / R1) and, on phones and tablets, the buttons that open Delphis\' menu; every other button goes straight to the game. On Android 11 and up it takes a small picture of the game\'s screen when a save is made, kept only on this device. With a trackpad preset it passes your bottom-screen trackpad to Dolphin\'s touch pointer.
